Keep your phone on the router’s Wi-Fi and connect the PC by Ethernet. Select UEFI PXE IPv4 when the PC starts. Keep both devices on the same network and the server running until the transfer finishes. Configure the Freebox once in Help.
Setup is manual. PocketInstall does not change your router settings. Reserve an IP address for the phone; otherwise you will need to export the configuration again.
Addresses and logs are for troubleshooting. An HTTP request does not prove startup: WinPE and Windows must send their own confirmations. Manual commands are intended for tests.
Progress follows actual signals from the PC. “WinPE sent” means files were transferred, not that WinPE started. If the first Windows boot signal does not reach the phone, check it on the PC screen.

WinPE boots the PC and prepares installation. Import PocketInstall-WinPE-x64.zip from the release once. Files, integrity, and HTTP routes are checked before it becomes available. Prepare the Windows ISO separately in Windows.
Choose the version and edition matching your license. Microsoft’s image contains Home and Pro. Windows 10 standard support has ended; check your update coverage.

Import an official Microsoft ISO, or sources/install.wim or install.esd extracted from it. The WinPE ZIP contains the boot environment, not Windows. Allow 15–20 GB free on the phone for downloading and preparation. You can supply an official SHA-256 to verify the file.

Select the disk on the PC. A clean installation erases its partitions only after explicit confirmation. Small EFI, MSR, and recovery partitions stay hidden. In split mode, personal folders stay on C:; save files and games on D:. Hiding C: removes its icon without blocking access.

Calculation uses the selected edition size, 10 GiB for temporary files and 16 GiB for updates. It also covers WIM/ESD transfer and enforces a conservative minimum of 64 GiB for Windows 11 or 32 GiB for Windows 10. D: gets the remainder, at least 16 GiB. This is not a quota or a guarantee of free space after installing software.

Light removes Clipchamp, Solitaire, News, and Weather if present. Auto selects Light for PCs with less than 8 GB RAM or at most 2 cores, otherwise None. Windows Update, Defender, the Store, and drivers remain available. Edition selection is not automatic.
1. Start the server in Install. Reserve the phone’s IP in the Freebox DHCP leases.
2. Put this file and snponly.efi in the same Freebox TFTP folder. Enable TFTP for that folder.
3. In DHCP: TFTP server = Freebox IP; boot file = snponly.efi. Apply the settings.
For this version’s silent waiting, replace only pocketinstall.ipxe with the new export. Other settings stay the same.
